tool_1_ask_aj_consultant.title: Ask AJ – AI Garden & Landscape Consultant
features: Real-time streaming text responses with botanical domain intelligence
Image upload parser (analyzes balcony orientation, sun glare, space dimensions, plant issues)
Gurgaon-specific climate context (extreme summer 45°C heat, monsoon, winter smog resistance)
Pre-baked quick prompt chips: 'Best balcony plants for morning sun in DLF Phase 5', 'How to fix yellowing Areca Palm leaves', 'Cost of 500 sq ft terrace garden in Golf Course Ext'
Direct CTA at end of conversation: 'Export Chat & Book Nursery Visit on WhatsApp'

tool_2_ai_landscape_designer.title: AI Landscape Concept Generator
features: Space Type selector: Balcony (50-200 sqft), Terrace / Rooftop (300-2500 sqft), Villa Front / Backyard (1000-8000 sqft), Corporate Office, Indoor Atrium
Upload space photo or video dropzone
Generates 3 distinctive concept tiers: 1. Minimalist Low-Maintenance (₹35k-75k), 2. Modern Biophilic with Vertical Wall (₹1.2L-2.5L), 3. Luxury Zen Oasis with Pergola & Drip Irrigation (₹3.5L-7L+)
Includes plant palette list, maintenance frequency rating, estimated implementation timeline (7-21 days)
Instant WhatsApp 'Get Architect On-Site Survey for This Concept' button

tool_3_ai_plant_doctor.title: AI Plant Doctor & Botanical Clinic
features: Sick plant leaf/stem photo upload with instant visual scanning animation
AI diagnosis covering: Overwatering / Root Rot, Underwatering & Heat Stress, Pest Infestation (Mealybugs, Spider Mites), Nutrient Deficiency (Nitrogen/Iron Chlorosis), Sunlight Scorching
Confidence score + Severity level (Mild / Moderate / Critical)
Step-by-step 7-day recovery protocol
Direct CTA: 'Order Organic Treatment Kit or Book Plant Doctor Home Visit (₹499)'

tool_4_plant_match_quiz.title: What Plant Should I Buy? (30-Second Quiz)
features: Step 1: Placement Area (Living Room / Bedroom Desk / High Balcony / Terrace Garden / Corporate Cabin)
Step 2: Sunlight Availability (Direct 4+ hours / Bright Indirect / Low Fluorescent light)
Step 3: Care Commitment (I forget to water / Moderate weekend care / Plant enthusiast)
Step 4: Special traits (Pet-Safe, Air-Purifier NASA rated, Flowering, High Oxygen night emitter)
Returns top 3 matched plants from catalog with price in INR, air purity index, and direct WhatsApp buy deep-link

tool_5_ai_proposal_generator.title: AI Instant Landscape Proposal Studio
features: Structured input form: Property Type, Area size in sq.ft, Location in Gurgaon, Desired features (Lawn, Vertical Garden, Fountain, Drip Automation, Lighting, Fruit trees), Estimated Budget Range (₹50k to ₹15L+)
Generates a complete multi-section formal Landscape Proposal document on AJ Heaven's Harvest official letterhead
Document includes: Executive Summary, Scope of Work, Recommended Botanical & Hardscape Palette, Phased Timeline, Itemized Cost Breakdown in INR, Warranty & Post-Installation Maintenance Guarantee
Actions: 'Print / Download as PDF', 'Share to WhatsApp', and 'Save & Request Physical Survey'

Provide PIN admin dashboard at /admin with responsive table, metric cards (Total Leads, Hot Leads, Generated Proposals, Revenue Pipeline), lead status filter, and WhatsApp 1-tap message dispatch.
Maintain high aesthetic standards: Deep botanical greens, warm cream stone backgrounds, crisp emerald accent borders, smooth motion transitions, no generic AI slop.
